gloss: lingering snow; snow that stays until spring

definitions.gloss: lingering snow; permanent snowpack; snow that remains until spring
definitions.explanation: Snow that accumulates on the ground and does not melt until the following spring. Common in snowy regions of Japan such as Hokkaido and the Japan Sea side of Honshu.

examples.japanese: {根雪|ねゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{根雪|ねゆき}になった。
examples.english: The snow that fell in December became lingering snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧、⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{根雪|ねゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧、⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, lingering snow typically starts in late November and lasts until April.

notes:
A seasonal term closely tied to Japan's snowy regions. Once snow becomes {根雪|ねゆき}, it signals the beginning of the long winter and the landscape remains white until the thaw in spring.

FORMS:
⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ (root, base) + ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow) — snow that has "taken root" on the ground.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根雪|ねゆき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become permanent snow cover
- {根雪|ねゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧: for the lingering snow to melt
- {根雪|ねゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: for the permanent snow cover to begin

CULTURAL NOTE:
In snowy areas of Japan, the first snowfall that becomes {根雪|ねゆき} is a significant seasonal marker. Weather reports in these regions track when {根雪|ねゆき} begins and ends each year.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{初雪|はつゆき}→初雪：11784_hatsuyuki⟧: first snowfall of the season
- ⟦{残雪|ざんせつ}→残雪：21062_zansetsu⟧: remaining snow (in spring) — overlaps with {根雪|ねゆき} but ⟦{残雪|ざんせつ}→残雪：21062_zansetsu⟧ focuses on the melting phase
- {万年雪|まんねんゆき}: perennial snow (on mountaintops year-round)
